Time-independent Schrödinger equation
∵ Schrödinger's wave function(t,x) = Time(t)･Space(x),
-√1･h/2π･dTime(t)/dt･Space(x)
=Time(t)･Quantized_Hamiltonian{x,√1･h/2π(∂/∂x,∂/∂y,∂/∂z)}･Space(x)
→∇(nabla)≡(∂/∂x,∂/∂y,∂/∂z) , div{Time(t)･Space(x)}→
-√1･h/2π･dTime(t)/dt/Time(t)
=Quantized_Hamiltonian(x,√1･h/2π∇)･Space(x)/Space(x)
Let constant be E(Energy).
E･Time(t)=-√1･h/2π･dTime(t)/dt ,
∴ E･Space(x)=Quantized_Hamiltonian(x,√1･h/2π∇)･Space(x)

entry.text: The time-independent Schrödinger equation predicts that wave functions can form standing waves, called stationary states. These states are important in their own right, and if the stationary states are classified and understood, then it becomes easier to solve the time-dependent Schrödinger equation for any state. The time-independent Schrödinger equation is the equation describing stationary states.

entry.text: パティシエ日本一を決める大会のため、日夜特訓をする子。だが、センス無き為、予選敗退。何故自分はダメなのか、こんなに人一倍頑張っているのに、悔しさと憤りで発症。お菓子の国を作り、自分が女王様になってみんなに万歳される世界を創造するが、三食毎日ケーキやお菓子なのでみんな基本死亡コース。
entry.zh: 为了决出日本第一的甜品师而日夜特训的孩子。可是没有天分，预赛就败了。明明比谁都努力，为什么自己还是不行，就在不甘和愤懑中发病。造出一个点心之国，自己当上女王、接受所有人欢呼，但一日三餐全是蛋糕和点心，所以大家基本上都得死。
